statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate
There is clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service is for continuous rhythm monitoring
The associated symptom of palpitations is documented with ICD-10 code R00.2
The diagnosis code I47.1 was used
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
